title: Hepatitis C Virus in Neutrophil Granulocyte Progenitor Cells
brief_summary: Patients with hepatitis C show impaired neutrophil function. It is not known whether this is a direct of an indirect phenomenon. Using bone marrow biopsies from patients with hepatitis C it is possible to see whether neutrophil granulocyte progenitors are already infected with hepatitis C.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* chronic hepatitis C
* Genotype 1-4

Exclusion Criteria:

* acute hepatitis C
study_population: cells and tissue from patients with chronic hepatitis C virus infection
